title: Labels and descriptions with &
objective: Use the & operator to join cells and fixed text into a label and a full article description.
instructions: Build two pieces of text for each article. In G2:G6, make a label in the form NBO-0123 | Canvas sneaker | 42: the store, a hyphen, the article number, then a space, a bar, a space, the product, a space, a bar, a space and the size. In H2:H6, make a description in the form Canvas sneaker - white, size 42, KES 1999: the product, a space, a hyphen, a space, the colour, a comma and a space, the word size, a space, the size, a comma and a space, KES, a space and the price. Join the pieces with & and put fixed text in double quotes.
hints: The & operator joins text. =A2&B2 puts the two cells side by side with nothing between them. Fixed text goes in double quotes: =A2&"-"&B2.
Spaces count, so a separator like " | " has a space before and after the bar, inside the quotes. For the label: =A2&"-"&B2&" | "&C2&" | "&E2.
Numbers join as text exactly as they appear, so 42 becomes 42 and 1999 becomes 1999. For the description: =C2&" - "&D2&", size "&E2&", KES "&F2.
